But that's the mapped reaction? Actually the entry includes 'mapped_rxn': '[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([CH:7]2[CH2:8][C:9](=[O:10])[c:11]3[cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15][c:16]3[O:17]2)[cH:18]1' Wait that seems to be only product? Actually mapped_rxn likely includes full reaction: product>>reactants. In entry, mapped_rxn is that string, but seems incomplete. Let's re-examine entry 43208: It includes fields: 'mapped_rxn': '[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([CH:7]2[CH2:8][C:9](=[O:10])[c:11]3[cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15][c:16]3[O:17]2)[cH:18]1', 'product_smiles': '[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([CH:7]2[CH2:8][C:9](=[O:10])[c:11]3[cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15][c:16]3[O:17]2)[cH:18]1', 'reactant_smiles': 'O[CH2:8][C:9](=[O:10])[c:11]1[cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15][cH:16]1.[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([CH:7]=[O:17])[cH:18]1'

So mapped_rxn is just product? Might be missing arrow. But maybe the mapped_rxn is the reaction SMILES with mapping, but truncated? Actually typical mapped_rxn includes ">>". But here it's just product. Could be a bug. However the requirement: return the `mapped_rxn` associated with the template. So we can return the mapped_rxn field as given.

Thus answer: {'mapped_rxn': '[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([CH:7]2[CH2:8][C:9](=[O:10])[c:11]3[cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15][c:16]3[O:17]2)[cH:18]1', 'template_id': 43208}
